results.description:
The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS), in collaboration with the Ghana Navy Special Boat Squadron, has arrested 27 illegal miners, including a Chinese national, during a dawn raid at Anyinamso No. 2 in the Ashanti Region.

The suspects were reportedly engaged in illegal mining activities at night, with two armed men providing security using pump-action guns. The security personnel disarmed the men without incident and retrieved the two firearms.

results.title: The Vice-Chancellor of the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi (KNUST), Professor Christian Agyare, has led a delegat
results.description:
The Vice-Chancellor of the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi (KNUST), Professor Christian Agyare, has led a delegation to Dongfeng Special Vehicle Co. Ltd in China to discuss electric buses for campus transport and a proposed research and service centre.

The centre, to be based at KNUST in Kumasi, would serve Ghana and the wider West African market.

The visit to the company in Shiyan, Hubei Province, formed part of the delegation’s ongoing engagements in the province and was organised in partnership with Hubei University of Automotive Technology (HUAT).

results.title: Buoyed by zero tariffs, African exporters eye bigger China market🥑🥑🥑 Eight years after showcasing Kenyan avocados at the China International
results.description:
Buoyed by zero tariffs, African exporters eye bigger China market🥑🥑🥑

Eight years after showcasing Kenyan avocados at the China International Import Expo (CIIE), Tiku Shah is back in Shanghai with a bigger ambition: doubling his company's avocado shipments to China next year.

For Shah, managing director of Kenyan avocado exporter Sunripe, China's latest tariff cuts have given his expansion plans a boost.

On May 1, China extended zero-tariff treatment to all 53 African countries with which it maintains diplomatic ties, benefiting another 20 countries, including Kenya, Ghana and South Africa.

Six months into the expansion, the CIIE, the world's largest import-themed expo and now in its ninth edition, offers a glimpse of how African exporters are seeking to turn lower trade costs into bigger orders, new partnerships, and opportunities to expand production at home.
